text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, they're finally approaching the final 
corner! Just listen to this incredible 
roar from the crowd—!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I can hear it...! Everyone's voices! 
Their wishes! Begging me to hype things up 
even more!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(That's right, a race is... just like a 
festival! Then the Umamusume taking the 
lead should be—)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(It's me. I have to do it! This is my 
festival! I'll see this festival through 
to the end and—)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna become a Triple Crown 
Umamusume!!!!! SEIYAAAAAAAH!!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kitasan Black...! At the beginning, 
she was almost completely unknown, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
What a heart-gripping run! And at last, 
the Triple Crown...!! She's undoubtedly 
the real deal...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning the Triple Crown, a feat beyond 
even her idol Tokai Teio. Today's 
soul-stirring run powerfully shook the 
fans' unyielding hearts.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Nature-san! Thank you very much!
choice_data_list:
Congratulations on the Triple Crown, 
Kitasan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes, this is all thanks to the two of you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan, is it what I think? Were you 
running today with the determination of, 
"I won't let anyone say we're lacking just 
because Brusqueman isn't here!"?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um, let's see. More like not letting them 
say it, or...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I ran with the mindset to make it my race! 
Like, "Today's the Kitasan Festival!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Kitasan... Festival!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"If it were me, it'd be a 'Nature-san 
Festival,' huh..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No way, no way, no way...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I take it back. She really is an 
Umamusume from the sparkling side.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
How you bounce back after taking a hit 
makes all the difference. Man, give me a 
break... I can't deal with this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as she shrugged her shoulders, Nice 
Nature looked happy.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan. I was watching your race.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Aaaah, Teio-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Tokai Teio also rushed over to offer 
her congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san, thank you so much... Truly! I 
was finally able to make it this far!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The day I first saw you run, my... My 
dream began to race forward. And then—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So much has happened to bring us here... 
But it was all because you were there for 
me, Teio-san...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Congratulations, Kita-chan. I'm 
as happy as if it happened to me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...That's what I intended to say, anyway. 
Until I saw the race.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wait, before watching...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan is my cute junior. I've always 
looked at her that way, but—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I stopped thinking that, just a bit. 
Because she achieved what I couldn't, and 
etched her name into history today.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —As a Triple Crown Umamusume, you mean.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
T-Teio-san... But being able to run in all 
three Triple Crown races was just pure 
luck for me...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san too, if nothing had happened, she 
definitely would have!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't luck. With your toughness, you 
ran through the autumn season that I 
couldn't conquer.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That is the strength of you and the person 
who supported you. So please, hold your 
head high.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Teio-san...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Those eyes of yours... They haven't 
changed since we were little. Always 
gazing straight and fiercely toward what 
you admire...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The first time I saw those eyes, maybe I 
was secretly wishing for a day like this 
to come.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
For the day when you—stand side by side 
with me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio's face lacked her usual 
childlike innocence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tinged with frustration and fighting 
spirit, it was unmistakably the expression 
of a champion.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Kita-chan. Sorry, but just for 
today, let me tell you how I truly feel.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It just means you gave a run worthy of it, 
that's all. It was a truly great run. See 
ya.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Yes! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black kept her head bowed deeply 
until Tokai Teio's back was completely out 
of sight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, yet another major event took 
place.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Triple Crown Umamusume! If you can 
achieve this much, it's a splendid 
success. As of today, you graduate from 
the Bakushin Academy!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A passing class rep must be on her way 
soon. To save another child in need.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-san!? Are you leaving already?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Providing aid is not solely your 
mission, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san... You taught me the most 
important thing of all!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin basically means... taking action! 
In any situation, just keep moving 
forward!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It might look simple, but keeping at it 
consistently is what's truly important!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I won't ever forget. Never.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Keep pushing forward. At the "Victory 
Club" where I grew up, "forward progress" 
was spelled with the characters for 
Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"The teacher gave me a big red 'X' when I 
wrote that, though! Well then, farewell! 
Let us all Bakushin toward tomorrow!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, just as quickly as she had 
arrived, Sakura Bakushin O departed like a 
whirlwind.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Our own tomorrows... That's right, 
tomorrow doesn't only come for me. Next 
is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Kitasan Black's Triple Crown 
victory, another new story begins to 
unfold beneath the pouring rain.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Goooo, Dia-chaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond wins her debut race in 
style! Victory in the 500-million-carat 
clash of young ladies! She truly is a 
rough diamond of the finest grade!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan... you did it! If we keep up this 
momentum...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I can win a G1 race too! I'll 
make my dream come true, and then...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Kita-chan. I'm a little behind, but 
I'll definitely catch up to you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So go on ahead and see for yourself! After 
the Classic Triple Crown. The race where 
we'll meet again next year—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Heading to the Arima Kinen, where 
Umamusume of both the Classic and Senior 
Classes gather all at once!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The "Arima Kinen"...! Trainer!?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's get on board first!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our next race was decided. A trial run for 
our dream a year early, we would enter the 
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best! I wanted the Kikuka Sho 
to be the Kitasan Festival, but next up is 
the real year-end festival!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Dad will be thrilled too! We've 
got to liven things up with all our might!
